home.eyebrow: A digital video library of childhood
home.title: Rewind to the beginning.
home.intro: Memorabilia turns the original blog back on — cartoons, shows, films, and old commercials we once waited for in front of the TV, now preserved as an open static archive.
home.archiveTitle: Memories that don’t depend on a server.
home.archiveText: The archive was recovered from snapshots of the original blog and converted into structured JSON. No database and no closed platform — its stories and locally preserved images can live on any static host.

collection.cartoons: The cartoons we waited for on Saturday mornings, collected in one place.
collection.series: Shows that always made one more episode sound like a good idea.
collection.movies: Movie nights, videotapes, and films that stayed part of growing up.
collection.commercials: Commercials from the days when we knew every line and hummed the jingles long after the programme ended.

about.title: Keeping childhood memories within reach.
about.intro: Memorabilia revives the original blog as a modern, open archive of cartoons, television series, films, and old commercials that shaped our childhoods.

preservation.title: Preserved from the old web
preservation.text: The first collection was recovered from snapshots of the original Memorabilia blog in the Wayback Machine, including article text, images, and source information wherever they survived.

open.title: Open by design
open.text: Every entry is stored as static JSON. There is no database or closed platform, so the archive can be read, reused, and hosted by other preservation projects.

growing.title: Still growing
growing.text: The recovered blog is a starting point. Missing media can be restored, incomplete records expanded, and new memories added as the collection continues to evolve.

origin.title: Four collections
origin.text: The archive brings together cartoons, television series, childhood films, and old commercials—including title-only records waiting for their stories to be rediscovered.

about.supportText: Maintaining the data, restoring media, and improving the website takes time. If Memorabilia brought back a good memory, you can support its continued preservation.

support.title: Enjoying the archive?
support.toast: A small coffee helps keep old memories preserved, organized, and available to everyone.

footer.copy: Made for everyone who ran home before the opening credits.
